Note that the case that all entries of Atrue and Btrue are

The goal of this paper is to ﬁnd a controller that stabi-
lizes the origin of the system (Atrue, Btrue). Since on the
basis of the data and the prior knowledge we cannot dis-
tinguish between (Atrue, Btrue) and any other system in
Σ, we need to ﬁnd a single controller that stabilizes the
origin of all systems in Σ. This motivates the following
deﬁnition of informative data for stabilization of poly-
nomial systems. In the rest of the paper, we assume that
F(0) = 0.
